quests.title: The Wreck Shore
quests.text: The crown's charts end at Stormscale Summit, {dir_from_giver:front_stormscale_summit/wreck_shore} across the water. Take a boat from the coast; the Shipwright at the stables sells one if you lack it. On the {name:front_stormscale_summit/wreck_shore}, defeat six Last Watchmen that walk the beach at night, and keep to the shelf and the channel, where the Kraken does not hunt.
quests.lesson: Island trip by boat; coin at the cap, no XP.

quests.title: Group: The Last-Offering
quests.text: {name:last_offering_ape} rules the {name:front_stormscale_summit/thunderwood} {dir_from_giver:last_offering_ape}, an elite ape that takes offerings and gives back bruises. Bring a full group. The crown pays for the story as much as for the deed.
quests.lesson: Optional group elite on the island.

quests.title: Bounty: Silver Ape Hair
quests.text: Glass-Knuckle Jungle Apes roam the {name:front_stormscale_summit/thunderwood} on Stormscale Summit by day. Bring me four Silver Ape Hair and I pay each time; the court tailors cannot get enough. The next bounty opens an hour after you hand this one in.
quests.lesson: Island salvage bounty: coin at the cap.
